lead.description: a comparison that uses a treatment contrast generated outside the study

overview_sentence: A [natural experiment](articles/natural-experiment.qmd) uses a treatment contrast that the study did not assign.

self_checks.title: Route means
self_checks.prompt: Long-route times are 30, 40, 50, and 40. Short-route times are 20, 25, 30, and 25. What is the contrast of means?
self_checks.answer: The means are 40 and 25, so the contrast is 15.

self_checks.title: Extra short trip
self_checks.prompt: One more short-route time of 20 is added, and the long-route mean stays 40. What is the new contrast?
self_checks.answer: The short-route mean is 24, so the contrast is 16.
